faq_heading: Homes near Delview Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Delview Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Delview Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Delview Secondary. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 2 km away.

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Delview Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Delview Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Delview Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Delview Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Walk the route to Delview Secondary the way a child would, and count the crossings and sidewalks.
